name: A decided finding becomes an eval case, and the dashboard reports it honestly
description: The model-free half of the L06 eval pipeline, end to end in a browser. From PR #482's Findings tab, expand the seeded ACCEPTED finding on src/config.ts:16 and turn it into an eval case, then do the same for the seeded DISMISSED finding on package.json:17 — the two the seed deliberately leaves un-cased. Then open the General Reviewer's Evals tab and confirm the set has grown from the seeded 8 to 10 — the assertion that makes the two clicks above load-bearing, since the seeded rows would render whether or not they worked — and finally follow the sidebar to the Eval Dashboard and read the three metric labels with '—' values, which is AC-21 exercised in a browser: on a hermetic stack no run has ever happened, so every denominator is 0 and a rounded 100% would be a fabrication. IT STOPS SHORT OF RUNNING AN EVAL: e2e/run.ts states this package triggers no LLM call and needs no API key, and scripts/e2e.sh supplies neither — the run-and-read-metrics half is AC-26's manual live run. Every asserted string is a seed literal (server/src/db/seed-evals.ts) or copy from client/messages/en/. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
